words.gloss: to those who do not have

literal: To those who do not have a wife who cherishes fame, there is no majestic walk like a bull before those who despise them.
translation: Those who do not have a wife who cherishes a good reputation cannot walk with the majestic stride of a bull in front of their detractors.
modern: புகழை விரும்பும் மனைவியைப் பெறாதவர்களுக்கு, தம்மை இகழ்ந்து பேசுபவர் முன்னால் காளையைப் போலப் பெருமிதத்தோடு நடக்கும் கம்பீர நடை இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the social standing a virtuous wife brings to her husband. The word 'இல்' (literally home) here represents the wife who is the soul of the household. If she does not cherish and protect the family's reputation ('புகழ்புரிந்த'), the husband loses his honor in society. Without this domestic strength, he cannot face his mockers ('இகழ்வார்') with confidence, losing the proud, majestic stride ('பீடு நடை') compared here to that of a strong bull ('ஏறு').
